title: Growth Product Manager roadmap
summary: A step-by-step guide to deepen your growth expertise, build a showcase portfolio, and prepare for senior roles. Focuses on metrics, experimentation, analytics, and professional product habits.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish core growth concepts and data fundamentals.

milestones.title: Growth fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Explain the end-to-end growth loop and key performance levers.

tasks.title: Read growth loop overview
tasks.description: Study the growth loop article on Reforge and note each stage.

tasks.title: Map a product funnel
tasks.description: Create a simple funnel diagram (awareness → signup → activation → retention) for a well-known app using a pen-and-paper sketch.

tasks.title: Identify key metrics
tasks.description: List the top 3 metrics for each funnel stage and define how they are calculated.

milestones.title: SQL basics for growth
milestones.outcome: Write basic queries to extract user event data.

tasks.title: Complete SQL intro on Khan Academy
tasks.description: Finish the first two modules covering SELECT, WHERE, and ORDER BY.

tasks.title: Query signup events
tasks.description: Using a sample dataset on Kaggle, write a query that counts daily sign-ups.

tasks.title: Create a retention table
tasks.description: Write a query that shows week-over-week retention for the first 4 weeks after signup.

tasks.title: Document query logic
tasks.description: Write a brief markdown file explaining each query step and assumptions.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Develop expertise in experimentation, copy, and prioritisation.

milestones.title: Experiment design
milestones.outcome: Design rigorous A/B tests with clear hypotheses and success criteria.

tasks.title: Read experiment design guide
tasks.description: Study the experiment design chapter on Optimizely’s blog and note the hypothesis framework.

tasks.title: Write three test hypotheses
tasks.description: Draft hypotheses for a signup button color, onboarding email subject, and pricing tier display.

tasks.title: Build an experiment plan template
tasks.description: Create a Google Sheet template that captures hypothesis, variants, metrics, sample size, and timeline.

tasks.title: Calculate sample size
tasks.description: Use an online calculator to determine required users for a 5% lift detection at 95% confidence.

tasks.title: Peer-review plan
tasks.description: Share the template with a colleague and incorporate feedback on clarity.

milestones.title: Copy & onboarding craft
milestones.outcome: Create persuasive copy and onboarding flows that improve activation.

tasks.title: Study onboarding teardown
tasks.description: Read the onboarding teardown article on Product Hunt and note key patterns.

tasks.title: Audit a signup page copy
tasks.description: Select a public SaaS signup page and list strengths and weaknesses of its headline and CTA.

tasks.title: Write revised copy
tasks.description: Draft alternative headlines and button copy aimed at increasing click-through by 10%.

tasks.title: Prototype onboarding flow
tasks.description: Use Figma to sketch a 3-step onboarding sequence with micro-copy for each step.

tasks.title: Test copy with peers
tasks.description: Present the new copy to two peers and record their immediate reactions.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate impact and process.

milestones.title: Funnel analysis project
milestones.outcome: Publish a detailed funnel analysis showing insights and recommendations.

tasks.title: Select a public product
tasks.description: Choose a well-known app (e.g., Spotify) and define its user funnel stages.

tasks.title: Gather data sources
tasks.description: Identify publicly available usage reports or scrape basic metrics using a tool like SimilarWeb.

tasks.title: Analyze drop-off points
tasks.description: Calculate conversion rates between each stage and highlight the biggest leaks.

tasks.title: Write analysis report
tasks.description: Compose a 2-page PDF with charts, insights, and three actionable recommendations.

tasks.title: Publish on Medium
tasks.description: Post the report on Medium, add tags, and share the link on LinkedIn.

milestones.title: Experiment backlog project
milestones.outcome: Deliver a prioritized backlog with sizing and impact estimates.

tasks.title: Collect experiment ideas
tasks.description: Brainstorm 15 ideas across acquisition, activation, and retention using the ICE framework.

tasks.title: Size each experiment
tasks.description: Estimate effort (person-days) and potential uplift for each idea.

tasks.title: Prioritise with ICE
tasks.description: Score each idea using Impact, Confidence, Ease and rank them.

tasks.title: Create backlog document
tasks.description: Build a Notion page that lists experiments, scores, and rollout timelines.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a PM
tasks.description: Share the backlog with a growth PM on LinkedIn and incorporate suggestions.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Advance analytics, refine prioritisation, and prepare for job or client interviews.

milestones.title: Advanced analytics tools
milestones.outcome: Navigate Mixpanel or Amplitude to build real-time dashboards.

tasks.title: Complete Amplitude free course
tasks.description: Finish the introductory Amplitude analytics course on their website.

tasks.title: Build a funnel dashboard
tasks.description: Create a live funnel report for sign-ups → activation using a demo workspace.

tasks.title: Set up cohort analysis
tasks.description: Configure a retention cohort chart to monitor week-over-week activation retention.

tasks.title: Document insights workflow
tasks.description: Write a short guide on how you’ll use the dashboard for weekly decision meetings.

tasks.title: Share dashboard with mentor
tasks.description: Invite a senior growth PM to review the dashboard and suggest improvements.

milestones.title: Prioritisation
milestones.outcome: Apply systematic frameworks to choose high-impact growth initiatives.

tasks.title: Read RICE framework article
tasks.description: Study the RICE prioritisation article on Intercom’s blog and note each component.

tasks.title: Score past projects
tasks.description: Apply RICE to three of your previous growth experiments and record the results.

tasks.title: Create a prioritisation matrix
tasks.description: Build an Excel matrix that visualises RICE scores for upcoming ideas.

tasks.title: Facilitate a mock prioritisation meeting
tasks.description: Run a 30-minute session with a peer group to decide the next experiment using RICE.

tasks.title: Reflect on decision trade-offs
tasks.description: Write a brief note on what factors most influenced the final choices.

milestones.title: Job & client readiness
milestones.outcome: Present your portfolio confidently and articulate growth thinking in interviews.

tasks.title: Craft a 5-minute portfolio pitch
tasks.description: Prepare slides that walk through each portfolio project, focusing on impact and methodology.

tasks.title: Practice STAR interview answers
tasks.description: Write and rehearse STAR stories for metrics-driven decisions, experiment failures, and stakeholder alignment.

tasks.title: Mock interview with peer
tasks.description: Schedule a 30-minute mock interview with a product peer and request feedback on clarity.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn profile
tasks.description: Add the portfolio projects, key metrics, and skill tags to your profile summary.

tasks.title: Reflect on growth mindset
tasks.description: Journal about how you’ll continue learning and measuring growth after landing a role.
